key.name: current-workspace-only
key.summary: Cycle through the current workspace only
key.description: When enabled, only windows on the active workspace are part of the stacking order. Disable it to walk the stacking order of every window on every workspace.

key.name: wrap-around
key.summary: Wrap around at the ends of the stack
key.description: When enabled, tabbing past the bottom-most window continues at the top of the stack (and vice versa for the reverse direction).

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size in pixels of the application icons shown in the switcher.
